narrative.overview:
The user-selected ivory-and-cocoa editorial world now follows the supplied product: a pearl ivory, rose-gold double-ended foundation stick with WHITE formula and a built-in blending brush. The user states that the formula changes colour as it is applied and blended, adapting to skin tone. This is the supplied product proposition, not independent clinical evidence or a promise of universal tone suitability.

`public/images/product-duo.png` is retained as the authoritative source image; `source-assets/brand-board.jpeg` is the supplied identity reference. The first viewport serves responsive `product-duo-640.webp`, `product-duo-1024.webp`, and `product-duo-1536.webp` derivatives. The 3D fallback uses `product-duo-1024.webp`. The initial invented cocoa packaging and generated campaign are superseded. Cocoa interface styling must not become brown product casing.

This refresh records current `app/globals.css`, `components/NurrieHome.tsx`, `components/ColourReveal.tsx`, `components/KineticScene.tsx`, and the signup/privacy flow. Product truth belongs to `PRODUCT.md` and page strategy to `SURFACE.md`. This source-derived documentation does not certify browser review or publication status.

The owning task reports a passing scoped review of the saved `tablet-hero.jpg`, `tablet-colour.jpg`, and `mobile-colour.jpg` captures in `.impeccable/review`, successful keyboard slider checks, and no observed console errors. This evidence does not itself establish publication status.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory and paper interface surfaces with cocoa ink and inverse fields.
Exact supplied pearl-and-rose-gold product image leads; the foundation starts WHITE.
Large Gambarino statements, General Sans copy, square controls, and open compositions.
Dark cocoa section explains colour change through a keyboard-tested native slider and an authored textured SVG cream smear.
Secondary studio-lit 3D pair with white foundation and brush, kinetic lettering, motion alternatives, and supplied-image fallback.
Explicit consent, durable D1 signup, and private token-based removal.

rules.name: Interface and product are distinct
rules.body: Cocoa belongs to interface ink and fields. The supplied product remains pearl ivory with rose gold and WHITE formula.

rules.name: Illustration is not evidence
rules.body: Keep the colour slider qualifier visible. Its endpoints and percentage are not a shade match, universal suitability claim, or measured product result.

dos: **Do** preserve the supplied product-duo hero and fallback, white formula, and pearl/rose-gold packaging.
**Do** retain the illustrative qualifier beside the slider.
**Do** preserve editorial typography, warm surfaces, clear focus, keyboard controls, and motion alternatives.
**Do** keep explicit consent, durable registration, and private removal working.
**Do** verify rendered viewports and interactions before announcing visual approval.
donts: **Don’t** restore the rejected cocoa product or generated cocoa campaign.
**Don’t** add origin or Korean-manufacture claims, clinical results, universal tone suitability, mechanism, ingredients, SPF, wear duration, or certifications without support.
**Don’t** present the slider as a shade chart, personalised recommendation, or measured result.
**Don’t** make registration or product explanation depend on animation loading.
**Don’t** treat source documentation as visual-test or publication evidence.
